title: Set up the Facebook (Meta) Pixel and Conversion API

sections.title: Conversions API access token
sections.summary: In the same pixel's Settings scroll to Conversions API and click Generate access token; copy it once — Meta does not show it again. Paste it into the Facebook Conversions API integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
sections.verifyHint: A server event carrying fbc/fbp appears in Events Manager → Test events.

sections.title: Pixel ID from Meta Events Manager
sections.summary: Open Meta Events Manager, choose Data sources, select your pixel and open Settings: the Pixel ID is shown at the top. Paste it into the Facebook Pixel integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
sections.verifyHint: Events Manager → Test events shows PageView from the published funnel URL.
